changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS password_reset_token ( password_reset_token_id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, token VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, authorized_user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, expiry_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, created_by VARCHAR(255), created_at TIMESTAMP, modified_by VARCHAR(255), modified_at TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT fk_password_reset_token_user_id FOREIGN KEY (authorized_user_id) REFERENCES authorized_user(authorized_user_id) );

changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS authority_list ( authority_list_id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL, authority_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, description VARCHAR(255) NULL, resource_pattern VARCHAR(255) NULL, created_by VARCHAR(255), created_at TIMESTAMP, modified_by VARCHAR(255), modified_at TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT authority_list_pkey PRIMARY KEY (authority_list_id), CONSTRAINT uk_authority_name UNIQUE (authority_name) ); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS role_authority ( role_list_id BIGINT NOT NULL, authority_list_id BIGINT NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT role_authority_pkey PRIMARY KEY (role_list_id, authority_list_id), CONSTRAINT fk_role_authority_role_list FOREIGN KEY (role_list_id) REFERENCES role_list (role_list_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT fk_role_authority_authority_list FOREIGN KEY (authority_list_id) REFERENCES authority_list (authority_list_id) ON DELETE CASCADE );
